OFFICIAL IELTS.ORG SPECIFICATION STANDARD
IELTS Listening Master Test Form: 6 Core Question Groups
Khung mẫu nhận diện 6 nhóm câu hỏi chính thức và các biến thể trình bày cho IELTS Listening Parser

GROUP 1: MULTIPLE CHOICE LISTENING-G1

Questions 1–2 (Single Answer Variant - 3 Options)
Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.
1 What is the main reason for the customer's call?
A To inquire about room availability
B To report a missing luggage item
C To confirm a conference booking
2 The speaker recommends visiting the local museum because
A entry is free for international students.
B it holds a newly opened interactive exhibition.
C it is within walking distance from the station.

Questions 3–4 (Multiple Answers Variant - Choose TWO)
Choose TWO letters, A–E. Which TWO facilities are included in the rental price?
3–4 Select two correct answers:
A Underground parking B High-speed internet
C Swimming pool access D Weekly cleaning service
E Breakfast buffet

GROUP 2: MATCHING LISTENING-G2

Questions 5–7 (Matching Opinions / Features)
What comment does the speaker make about each of the following city areas? Write the correct letter, A–E, next to Questions 5–7.
COMMENTS / OPINIONS
A Recently renovated B Overcrowded at weekends
C Suitable for family picnics D Expensive parking fees
E Closed during winter
5 Central Park [ 5 ]
6 Harbour Promenade [ 6 ]
7 Old Town Square [ 7 ]

GROUP 3: PLAN / MAP / DIAGRAM LABELLING LISTENING-G3

Questions 8–10 (Map / Plan Labelling with Option Box)
Label the map below. Write the correct letter, A–F, next to Questions 8–10.
[ CAMPUS LIBRARY LAYOUT - GROUND FLOOR ]
Main Entrance Location [ A ] Location [ B ]
Location [ C ] Information Desk Location [ D ]
Location [ E ] Cafeteria Location [ F ]
8 Photocopying Room [ 8 ]
9 IT Helpdesk [ 9 ]
10 Silent Study Zone [ 10 ]

GROUP 4: FORM / NOTE / TABLE / FLOW-CHART / SUMMARY COMPLETION LISTENING-G4

Questions 11–12 (Form Completion)
Complete the form below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
STUDENT ACCOMMODATION REGISTRATION
Full Name: Sarah Jenkins
Contact Number: 11 ___________
Preferred Room Type: 12 ___________ studio

Questions 13–14 (Note Completion)
Complete the notes below. Write ONE WORD ONLY for each answer.
New Staff Induction Highlights
• Uniform must be collected from the 13 ___________ on Day 1.
• Parking permit requires submission of a valid driving 14 ___________ .

Questions 15–16 (Table Completion)
Complete the table below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer.
| Excursion Destination | Transport Mode | Key Attraction |
| Green Valley National Park | Express Bus | Guided 15 ___________ |
| Coastal Marine Centre | 16 ___________ | Dolphin feeding demonstration |

Questions 17–18 (Flow-chart Completion)
Complete the flow-chart below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS for each answer.
Step 1: Submit research proposal to academic supervisor
↓
Step 2: Obtain ethical approval from the department 17 ___________
↓
Step 3: Conduct online survey and compile data 18 ___________

GROUP 5: SENTENCE COMPLETION LISTENING-G5

Questions 19–20
Complete the sentences below. Write NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
19 The annual student art exhibition will begin on the ___________ of October.
20 Visitors are advised to book their tickets through the official ___________ to avoid delays.

GROUP 6: SHORT-ANSWER QUESTIONS LISTENING-G6

Questions 21–22
Answer the questions below. Write NO MORE THAN THREE WORDS AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.
21 Which document must international students present during airport check-in? ___________
22 What time does the university main library close on Friday evenings? ___________
